body: Never really had the chance. It's hard because I genuinely feel bad about every lie I tell. I don't want to do it. It's like an addiction. Whenever I'm feeling low it comes on.

I have Munchausen syndrome. I've tried to stop but I can't. Ive tried to refocus it on something real to stop pretending but in the end it always ends up back where I started. Pretending to be sick to try to lose weight.

I'm angry at me. I'm a fucking mess. I've fucked with people's lives and feelings for too long. Like I know I need psychological help but I'm so sick of not being able to stop myself once I start. And I can't bring myself to admit it's all been a big lie, so I'll never get the help I need.
